assumptions: Scope: approved-revenue rows with a Customer ID only; rows without one are excluded (see revenue_share_without_customer_id), so customer totals do not reconcile to total revenue.
Monetary = approved (gross) revenue per customer; cancellations are never netted in and are reported separately per customer as cancel_value (C invoices, product codes).
Frequency = distinct purchase days (same-day split invoices count once); distinct invoices kept as orders.
Recency = days from last purchase day to snapshot 2011-12-10 (day after the last invoice). Dec 2011 is partial (1-9 Dec).
R, F, M scored 1-5 by quintile of percentile rank (ties share a score; recent = 5). Segments follow the ordered rule table in rfm_segment_rules.csv (first match wins).
Country per customer = country on most of their revenue lines (ties alphabetical); 12 customers have revenue lines in >1 (13 if cancellation rows are counted).
Usual gap = median days between a customer's consecutive purchase days (2+ purchase days needed).
High-value at risk = top 20% by monetary, 2+ purchase days, recency > 2 x usual gap and > 90 days. One-day high-value customers are counted separately (no usual gap).
Reversed sales = revenue lines cancelled by the same customer within 24h (data-quality rule). Kept in monetary per the approved definition, flagged, and removed in the sensitivity views.
Dec 2009 is the first month of data: customers first seen then are left-censored (flag starts_dec2009) and are a cohort baseline, not acquisition.
Repeat-within-180-days metrics use customers first seen from 2010-01-01 with at least 180 days of observation before the snapshot.

revenue_identified.definition: Approved revenue on rows with a Customer ID

revenue_share_without_customer_id.definition: Share of approved revenue with no Customer ID (excluded from all customer metrics)

customers.definition: Distinct Customer IDs with approved revenue

customers_cancel_only.definition: Customer IDs with cancellations but no approved revenue (not in RFM)

customers_multi_country.definition: Customers with revenue lines in >1 country; assigned their modal country

customers_starting_dec2009.definition: Customers first seen in Dec 2009 (left-censored history)

top_1pct_customer_share.definition: Identified revenue share of top 1% customers

top_10pct_customer_share.definition: Identified revenue share of top 10% customers

top_20pct_customer_share.definition: Identified revenue share of top 20% customers

top_1pct_share_excl_reversed.definition: As top_1pct_customer_share with reversed sales removed

reversed_value_identified.definition: Revenue on lines reversed by the same customer within 24h (kept in monetary)

top20_changed_by_reversals.definition: Customers who leave the top 20% when reversed sales are removed

customer_cancel_value.definition: Cancelled product value of identified customers (C invoices; not netted into monetary)

segment_revenue_share_champions.definition: Share of identified revenue from Champions (1321 customers)

segment_revenue_share_loyal.definition: Share of identified revenue from Loyal (1202 customers)

segment_revenue_share_big_spenders.definition: Share of identified revenue from Big spenders (85 customers)

segment_revenue_share_new.definition: Share of identified revenue from New (240 customers)

segment_revenue_share_cant_lose.definition: Share of identified revenue from Can't lose (252 customers)

segment_revenue_share_at_risk.definition: Share of identified revenue from At risk (702 customers)

segment_revenue_share_need_attention.definition: Share of identified revenue from Need attention (665 customers)

segment_revenue_share_hibernating.definition: Share of identified revenue from Hibernating (1385 customers)

high_value_at_risk_customers.definition: Top 20% by monetary, 2+ purchase days, recency > 2x usual gap and > 90 days

high_value_at_risk_revenue_FY2.definition: Their FY2 (Dec10-Nov11) revenue: the annual revenue at stake

high_value_at_risk_flagged.definition: At-risk customers with a distortion flag other than starts_dec2009

high_value_at_risk_customers_excl_revers.definition: At-risk count when top 20% is ranked on monetary excluding reversed sales

high_value_oneoff_lapsed_customers.definition: Top-20% customers with one purchase day and recency > 90 days (no usual gap; not in at-risk list)

at_risk_count_range.definition: Min-max at-risk count across the sensitivity grid

at_risk_monetary_range.definition: Min-max at-risk monetary across the grid

median_days_first_to_second.definition: Median days from first to second purchase day (repeaters)

median_usual_gap_days.definition: Median over repeaters of their median gap between consecutive purchase days

median_mean_gap_days.definition: Median of (last-first)/(purchase days-1); matches median_days_between_purchases in outputs/analysis/metrics.json

customers_single_order_dominated_top20.definition: Top-20% customers whose largest purchase day is >=50% of monetary and >=£5,000

top20_share_starting_dec2009.definition: Share of top-20% customers first seen in Dec 2009 (history left-censored)

repeat_rate_new_2010_2011.definition: Repeat rate excluding customers first seen in Dec 2009

repeat_within_90d.definition: Eligible new customers (first seen Jan 2010-Jun 2011) buying again within 90 days

repeat_within_180d_FY1_new.definition: New customers first buying Jan-Jun 2010 who bought again within 180 days

repeat_within_180d_FY2_new.definition: New customers first buying Jan-Jun 2011 who bought again within 180 days

default_at_risk_row.definition: Default row of the sensitivity grid
